brief: 5 privacy-first product tools that don't sell your usage data.

slots.subline: Secure products for teams that value data sovereignty

slots.heroBody: Get actionable insights from your website traffic without collecting personal data or using cookies.
slots.slideSubtitle: GDPR-compliant out of the box, no cookie banner required, and fully open source.

slots.heroBody: Store, share, and autofill credentials across every device with end-to-end encryption.
slots.slideSubtitle: Zero-knowledge architecture means even Bitwarden cannot read your vault contents.

slots.heroBody: Create unlimited email aliases to hide your real address and stop spam in its tracks.
slots.slideSubtitle: Reply anonymously through aliases and protect your identity across every signup.

slots.heroBody: Capture ideas, tasks, and documents in a private workspace that syncs everywhere securely.
slots.slideSubtitle: AES-256 encryption keeps your notes readable only by you, not the server or staff.

slots.heroBody: Send and receive messages protected by PGP encryption with servers based in Switzerland.
slots.slideSubtitle: No ads, no tracking, and no scanning your emails to build a profile.

slots.heroBody: Send texts, calls, and files with end-to-end encryption trusted by journalists worldwide.
slots.slideSubtitle: Open-source protocols and nonprofit funding mean your chats are never mined for ads.

slots.eyebrow: the rest is up to you
slots.sublineItalic: Switch to tools that treat your data like it belongs to you, not their bottom line.
